subject: Intro request: AWS co-sell with Scorpion Health — propose JAP + kickoff
messages:
From: Emma Liu <emma.liu@amazon.com>
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 6 Jun 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: AWS co-sell intro: Scorpion Health (potential pilot)

Hi Neha / Karthik,

Hope you are both well — quick intro from the AWS Partner Co-sell team. I’m working with Scorpion Health; they’re evaluating LLM-based clinical documentation assistants and asked about options for a marketplace listing + joint go-to-market. Given Redwood’s inference story, I think there’s a clear fit to run a pilot on Dedicated capacity (data isolation + SLA).

Would you be open to a short intro call with Scorpion’s product and procurement leads to:
- Confirm technical fit and proposed deployment model
- Walk through co-sell incentives and marketplace listing cadence
- Draft a mutual action plan (JAP) to get from POC -> pilot -> co-sell listing

Proposed attendees from AWS: Emma Liu (Partner Manager), Sam Patel (Solutions SA). From Scorpion: Jason Morales (Head of Product), procurement@scorpionhealth.com (copying).

If that sounds good, can you share 30–45 min availability this week? I’ve attached the AWS co-sell checklist for reference (attachment).

Thanks — Emma

Attachments: AWS_CoSell_Checklist.pdf (1 page)
Links: https://aws.amazon.com/partner-network/co-sell
From: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@amazon.com>, Jason Morales <jason@scorpionhealth.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 09:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: AWS co-sell intro: Scorpion Health (potential pilot)

Hi Emma / Jason — thanks for the intro.

We’d love to connect. Quick notes:
- Suggested goal for first call: 20–30m discovery to align on goals, sample data constraints, and timeline for a pilot.
- Please confirm whether Scorpion prefers a hosted API test or Dedicated pool for the pilot — both are possible but change SOW and timelines.

Availability this week (ET):
- Tue 6/8: 11:00–11:45am or 3:30–4:15pm
- Wed 6/9: 10:00–11:00am or 2:00–2:45pm

I’ve cc’d Karthik (solutions) and Vivek (marketplace/partnerships) — joining to help scope the JAP and listing path.

Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: (none in this reply)
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, Emma Liu <emma.liu@amazon.com>, Jason Morales <jason@scorpionhealth.com>
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 01:12:00 +0530
Subject: Re: AWS co-sell intro: Scorpion Health (potential pilot)

Thanks — I’ll take the tech lead on the call. Proposed short agenda (20–30m):
1) Intros & business objectives (5m)
2) Data/privacy constraints and compliance baseline (SOC2, PHI concerns) (7–8m)
3) Recommended pilot architecture: Redwood Dedicated vs Hosted API + timeline implications (7–8m)
4) Next steps: agree JAP owner, timeline to pilot, go/no-go criteria (3–5m)

Pre-reads: I uploaded a JAP draft (JAP_Draft_v1.docx) and our marketplace checklist. Also, if Scorpion can share a single example flow (pseudo-data) ahead of time, that helps speed the architecture recommendation.

Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference

Attachments: JAP_Draft_v1.docx, Redwood_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx
Links: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cJAPdraft
From: Jason Morales <jason@scorpionhealth.com>
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, Emma Liu <emma.liu@amazon.com>
Cc: procurement@scorpionhealth.com
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 11:09:00 -0400
Subject: Re: AWS co-sell intro: Scorpion Health (potential pilot)

Hi all — excited to meet. We can do Tue 6/8 at 3:30pm ET (that works for product and procurement). A couple of things for the call so we’re efficient:
- Procurement will want to understand data residency (we host some PHI) and whether Dedicated can be deployed in our VPC / with customer-managed keys.
- Security team asked for SOC2 scope and retention policy summary — can you share a short doc?
- We’ll bring a technical PM (Sara) and a procurement rep (Tom).

See you at 3:30pm ET.

—Jason
From: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Jason Morales <jason@scorpionhealth.com>, Emma Liu <emma.liu@amazon.com>, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 20:50:00 +0530
Subject: Re: AWS co-sell intro: Scorpion Health (potential pilot)

Great — thanks Jason. Calendar invite sent for Tue 6/8 3:30pm ET / 12:30pm PT. Agenda and JAP will be attached to the invite. Quick checklist I’ll bring to the call:
- Confirm pilot scope (data flow + PII/PHI handling)
- Decide Dedicated vs Hosted proof-of-concept and estimated lead time
- Identify JAP owner and gate dates for pilot readiness
- Procurement asks: KMS options, SOC2 evidence, contract template timeline

Attaching our security questionnaire response and a one-page pilot checklist for procurement. I’ll own the JAP updates post-call and circulate a revised Redwood_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx by EOD Wed.

Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Security_Questionnaire_Response.pdf, Redwood_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx
